parameter_meaning: Two time-independent material/contact scenarios span the previously examined endpoints. Closed-contact stiffness is a compliance scenario, not a monitored degradation parameter. Irreversible damage evolves within each complete seven-step force path, starting from its learned loaded reference state.
representation: One common material-parameter network predicts seven states. The recorded path_coordinates selects either reference-increment or absolute-state optimization coordinates; both use the same fixed-reference physical observations. All four reflection sectors remain active for every material input. Actual force/rod/support arrays set physical step order. Material history is recomputed from absolute displacements at every optimization evaluation.
initialization: The same saved 30-GPa, 200-GPa/m force path initializes every material query. Other material paths are not training labels. The complete force residual supplies training, including the reference step.
purpose: Establish the complete force-driven shared PINN and assess its regional material responses and fixed-calibration readout before developing the coupled regional/history training method. Segment lengths expose response evolution and are not scientific acceptance thresholds.
